text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks A, D, and E just because they were above my average cost may have cut short future gains; I should judge each trade by its prospects and my overall portfolio, not by locking in a gain.","I tend to treat each stock as a separate account and dislike admitting a loss. Average cost is not a reason to hold a stock, so I should reassess it objectively rather than let regret guide me.","I rarely trade, and my recent account value has been fairly steady. I should avoid reacting to small month-to-month moves and make deliberate decisions that keep my overall risk and diversification in view."]}
